name: Let's Go Motorhomes
verdict: Australian motorhome rental company owned by Jayco, the family-owned RV maker; nothing found.
note: Australian motorhome and campervan rental company; its 'letsgo' mark is on the collar and lower back of the 2026 Team Jayco AlUla jersey. A January 2017 press release says Jayco acquired the rental company Around Australia Motorhomes and rebranded it as Let's Go Motorhomes, and the company's own site still says it is 'proudly backed by Jayco' (claim letsgo-jayco-acquisition-ownership), so Jayco Corporation is the owner. No human-rights finding about Let's Go Motorhomes was found.
